Walk: 6 legs · Metro Line 1, Toledo to Duomo: 1 leg · Metro Line 1, Museo to Municipio: 1 leg · about 1 h 4 min on foot

PHOTO TIPS AT YOUR STOPS
La Rambla & La Boqueria market: Shoot the Boqueria's stained-glass entrance from across La Rambla to get the crowd in the frame.
Gothic Quarter & Cathedral: The Pont del Bisbe, a carved stone bridge on Carrer del Bisbe, is the most photographed corner of the quarter.
Santa Maria del Mar: Sit in the back pews and shoot up the nave toward the altar.
El Born Centre de Cultura: Shoot the excavations from the walkway with the iron roof in the frame.

Sun times are calculated for Barcelona. Viewpoints are from OpenStreetMap.

Getting around, costs and local words
GETTING AROUND TODAY

Taxi or car: 1 leg · Walk: 7 legs · about 51 min on foot

Metro: Fast and frequent. A T-casual card gives one person 10 rides on metro, bus and tram, and works out much cheaper than single tickets.
Walking: The old town, El Born and the Eixample are best on foot. Sagrada Família and Park Güell are a metro or taxi ride away.
Taxi: Black-and-yellow taxis are easy to hail and the FreeNow app works. Port to the center is about 10 to 15 minutes.
From the cruise port: The blue Portbus shuttle runs from the terminals to the Columbus Monument at the bottom of La Rambla.
